title: Providence
definition: Providence is God's wise, holy, and sovereign care by which He preserves, governs, and directs all things according to His purposes.
summary: The doctrine of providence teaches that God is not distant from His creation. He sustains all things, rules over history, cares for His people, and works even through suffering and human actions to accomplish His will. Providence does not remove human responsibility, nor does it make God the author of evil. It teaches believers to trust God's wisdom, rest in His care, pray with confidence, and obey faithfully even when circumstances are difficult.
christFocus: God's providential care is seen most clearly in Christ Jesus. Through the cross, God worked through human evil to accomplish redemption, showing that His purposes are wise, holy, and victorious.

studySections.heading: God Preserves All Things
studySections.content: Creation continues because God upholds it. Life, breath, seasons, and daily provision are under His sustaining care.

studySections.heading: God Governs History
studySections.content: Scripture shows that nations, rulers, events, and personal lives are under God's sovereign rule.

studySections.heading: God Works for His People's Good
studySections.content: Believers can trust that God is working all things together for His redemptive purpose in Christ, even when His ways are not fully understood.
